Selection threshold curve with the frozen cutoff of 0.275. Test labels do not choose the cutoff.

Global SHAP across all test customers: horizontal position is signed contribution; color shows feature values, with numeric features in source units.
Age dependence: each dot is a test customer; the line is the mean contribution at each observed age, measured in years.
Product-count dependence: customer contributions and means by product count; interpret the minority groups alongside sample sizes.
Activity dependence: 0 denotes inactive and 1 active; the vertical axis measures contribution to this model's score.
Tenure dependence in source values: negative contributions lower the score relative to the model baseline; they do not establish a causal protective effect.
Local contributions for four outcome groups: red raises and blue lowers the score; all 12 columns are retained in each panel and contributions plus the baseline reconstruct log-odds.
